search.label: Search networks
search.placeholder: Search by name, driver, subnet or stack

list.inUseBy: In use by {{what}}. Open it to see what uses it.

create.title: Create network
create.body: A network lets containers reach each other by name.

attachable.label: Attachable
attachable.helper: Lets standalone containers join an overlay network. Only for overlay networks on a swarm.

subnet.label: Subnet
subnet.helper: In CIDR form. Coaming warns if it overlaps another network but doesn't pick one for you.

overlap.one: This overlaps {{name}} ({{cidr}}). Containers on both networks may not reach each other. You can still create it.
overlap.two: This overlaps {{count}} networks: {{first}} and {{second}}. Containers on both networks may not reach each other. You can still create it.
overlap.many: This overlaps {{count}} networks: {{first}}, {{second}} and {{more}} more. Containers on both networks may not reach each other. You can still create it.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Containers can no longer use it. This can't be undone.
delete.builtin: {{name}} is built in and can't be deleted.
delete.inUse: {{name}} is still in use. Disconnect or remove what uses it, then try again.
delete.label: Delete network {{name}}

connect.title: Connect a container to {{network}}
connect.body: The container is on the network straight away.
connect.notAttachable: {{name}} isn't attachable, so standalone containers can't join it. Only swarm services can.
connect.own: This is one of Coaming's own containers. Putting it on another network changes what can reach it, so its name has to be typed first.

container.label: Container
container.empty: Every container is already on this network.

network.label: Network
network.empty: This container is on every network it can join.

alias.label: Alias (optional)
alias.helper: Another name other containers can use.

errors.addressInvalid: The network didn't accept that address. Enter one inside the network's subnet, like 10.20.0.5.
errors.nodeMismatch: {{network}} is local to one node, and {{container}} is on another. A container can only join a local network of its own node.
errors.notAttachable: {{network}} isn't attachable, so standalone containers can't join it. Only swarm services can.
errors.unavailableOnNode: That node doesn't know {{network}} yet, so {{container}} can't join it from there. Try again once a service that uses the network is running on that node.
errors.networkGone: {{network}} no longer exists. It may have been removed.
errors.containerGone: {{container}} no longer exists. It may have been removed.

disconnect.label: Disconnect {{container}} from {{network}}
disconnect.title: Disconnect {{container}} from {{network}}?
disconnect.body: It loses access to everything on that network straight away.
disconnect.own: This is one of Coaming's own containers. Taking it off a network can cut Coaming off from this host, and Coaming can't put it back once that happens.
disconnect.ownAsked: This is one of Coaming's own containers, so its name has to be typed first.

errors.nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and check the Coaming logs if it keeps happening.
errors.permission: You no longer have permission to do that. Your access may have changed.
errors.nodeUnreachable: That node isn't reachable right now. Try again when it's back.
errors.hostReadOnly: This host is read-only. Changes are turned off on the host itself, so Coaming can only read from it.
errors.gatewayOutside: The gateway must be inside the subnet.
errors.rangeOutside: The IP range must be inside the subnet.
errors.attachableOverlayOnly: Only an overlay network on a swarm can be attachable.
errors.overlayNeedsSwarm: An overlay network needs a swarm. This environment isn't one.

error.loadFailed: Couldn't load {{name}}. Docker may be unreachable. Try again.

gone.heading: This network is gone
gone.body: It was removed, or a deploy replaced it. Go back to the list to find it.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.empty: Nothing is attached to this network.
attachments.truncated: Aliases are shown for the first {{count, number}} containers only.

inspect.loadFailed: Couldn't load the inspect output of {{name}}.

inUse.title: {{name}} is in use
inUse.body: Disconnect or remove these first. Swarm services that mention this network count, even with no running tasks.

detail.builtin: {{name}} is built in and can't be deleted.
